title: Angular Developer
description: Build enterprise-grade, scalable single-page applications with Angular standalone components, Signals, RxJS reactive patterns, and NgRx.

goal.objective: Architect robust enterprise web applications using Angular’s strict opinionated ecosystem, dependency injection, and modern reactivity model.

learn.summary: Master Angular 17+, Standalone Components, Angular Signals, RxJS Observables, Reactive Forms, Router Guards, NgRx state management, and SSR with Angular Universal.

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Banking & Portfolio Management Portal
capstone_projects.description: Build a complex financial dashboard with real-time websocket price tickers, multi-step transaction forms, and strict role authorization.

capstone_projects.title: Multi-Tenant Enterprise Workflow Studio
capstone_projects.description: Architect a micro-frontend based enterprise admin portal using Angular standalone components, signal-based state primitives, dynamic form engines, and strict RBAC.

certifications: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Developer
interview_focus: Angular Change Detection Mechanics (Default vs OnPush)

tree.name: Foundational Web & Angular Concepts
tree.description: Grasp the essential web development prerequisites and the core introductory concepts of the Angular framework, TypeScript, and setting up your development environment for modern web development.

resources.title: Angular Crash Course for Beginners 2023 - Build an Angular App

children.name: Web Development Prerequisites (HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript ES6+)
children.description: Reinforce fundamental knowledge of HTML5 for structuring semantic web content, CSS3 for advanced styling and responsive design, and modern JavaScript (ES6+) for programming logic, asynchronous operations, and modularity, which are essential for any frontend development.

resources.title: Learn HTML5 and CSS3 From Scratch - Full Course
JavaScript Full Course for Beginners | Complete All-in-One Tutorial | 8 Hours

children.name: TypeScript Fundamentals
children.description: Learn TypeScript, the strongly-typed superset of JavaScript that powers Angular. Understand types, interfaces, classes, enums, generics, modules, decorators, and advanced type utilities to write robust and maintainable code.

children.name: Introduction to Angular & CLI
children.description: Understand what Angular is, its core architectural concepts (components, modules, services, dependency injection, change detection), and how to efficiently use the Angular CLI for project generation, scaffolding, building, serving applications, and managing configurations.

resources.title: Angular for Beginners Course [Full Front End Tutorial with TypeScript] (freeCodeCamp.org)
Angular 13 Tutorial #2 - Angular CLI & Project Structure

children.name: Environment Setup & Tooling
children.description: Set up your local development environment with essential tools: Node.js (runtime), npm/yarn (package managers), Visual Studio Code (with recommended Angular extensions), Git for version control, and browser developer tools for inspecting and debugging web applications.

resources.title: Node.js & NPM Crash Course | Learn How To Use Node & NPM
VS Code Setup for Web Development

tree.name: Building Blocks: Angular Core
tree.description: Master the fundamental building blocks of Angular applications, including components, data binding, services, modules, routing, forms, and reactive programming with RxJS for asynchronous operations and state management.

resources.title: Angular 17 Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course
Angular Course for Beginners - Learn Angular with TypeScript (Full Tutorial)

children.name: Components, Templates & Data Binding
children.description: Understand Angular components, their lifecycle hooks, templates (HTML), component-specific styles (CSS), template syntax, interpolation, property binding, event binding, two-way data binding, and component interaction using @Input() and @Output().

children.name: Directives & Pipes
children.description: Explore Angular's built-in structural directives (*ngIf, *ngFor, *ngSwitch), attribute directives ([ngClass], [ngStyle]), and built-in pipes (DatePipe, CurrencyPipe, AsyncPipe) for transforming and formatting data. Learn to create custom structural and attribute directives and custom pipes for reusable UI logic.

children.name: Services & Dependency Injection
children.description: Learn to create and use injectable services for encapsulating reusable business logic, data access, and sharing state across components. Master Angular's powerful dependency injection (DI) system for managing and providing dependencies, understanding providers, and hierarchical injectors.

resources.title: Angular Docs - Services and Dependency Injection
Angular Tutorial for Beginners: Services and Dependency Injection

children.name: Routing & Navigation
children.description: Implement client-side routing using Angular's RouterModule. Define routes, navigate programmatically, pass route parameters, use route guards (CanActivate, CanDeactivate, Resolve) for authorization and data pre-fetching, and implement lazy loading for performance optimization of feature modules.

resources.title: Angular Docs - Lazy Loading Feature Modules

children.name: Forms & User Input
children.description: Handle user input effectively with Angular forms. Learn about template-driven forms (FormsModule) and reactive forms (ReactiveFormsModule), including FormControls, FormGroups, and FormArrays. Implement robust validation techniques, including built-in validators, custom validators, and asynchronous validators.

resources.title: Angular Forms Tutorial (Template Driven & Reactive Forms)
Angular Reactive Forms Tutorial - Full Course (from scratch)

children.name: Reactive Programming with RxJS & HTTPClient
children.description: Understand reactive programming principles with RxJS. Work with Observables, Observers, Subscriptions, and key Operators (map, filter, switchMap, mergeMap, debounceTime, catchError, retry). Integrate with backend APIs using Angular's HttpClient module for making HTTP requests, error handling, and implementing HTTP interceptors.

resources.title: Angular Docs - Communicating with backend services (HttpClient)

tree.name: Advanced Concepts & Enterprise Development
tree.description: Dive into advanced Angular features, state management, complex architectural patterns, performance optimization, robust testing strategies, and preparing applications for production environments and large-scale enterprise use.

resources.title: Angular NgRx Tutorial - Learn State Management with NgRx

children.name: State Management Patterns
children.description: Learn various strategies for managing application state in large-scale Angular applications. Explore simple service-based patterns with RxJS, Flux/Redux patterns using NgRx (Store, Effects, Reducers, Selectors), and other solutions like NgXs or Akita for efficient and predictable state handling.

resources.title: NgRx Crash Course | Angular State Management

children.name: Performance, Optimization & Change Detection
children.description: Optimize Angular application performance through techniques like change detection strategies (OnPush), lazy loading of modules and routes, Ahead-of-Time (AOT) compilation, tree shaking for bundle size reduction, differential loading, Web Workers, and comprehensive performance profiling with browser dev tools and Angular DevTools.

children.name: Progressive Web Apps (PWA) & Offline Capabilities
children.description: Build robust web experiences by transforming Angular applications into Progressive Web Apps. Implement service workers for offline caching and network resilience, create a Web App Manifest for installability, and explore strategies for background sync and push notifications.

resources.title: Build a Progressive Web App (PWA) with Angular - Full Tutorial

children.name: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & SEO with Angular Universal
children.description: Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR) with Angular Universal to improve initial page load performance, enhance SEO, and provide a better user experience on slower networks. Understand state transfer and hydration for seamless client-side interactivity.

resources.title: Angular Docs - Server-Side Rendering with Universal
Angular SSR Tutorial - Server Side Rendering in Angular

children.name: Internationalization (i18n) & Localization
children.description: Add multi-language support (i18n) to Angular applications for a global audience. Learn about Angular's built-in i18n tooling for translating text, handling pluralization, date, currency, and number formatting, and adapting to right-to-left (RTL) layouts.

children.name: Testing & Debugging Angular Applications
children.description: Master comprehensive testing strategies including unit testing with Karma/Jasmine for services and components, integration testing, and end-to-end (E2E) testing with modern tools like Cypress or Playwright. Learn effective debugging techniques using browser developer tools, VS Code's debugger, and Angular DevTools.

resources.title: Angular Testing Tutorial - How to Unit Test your Components, Services, and Pipes
Cypress vs Playwright vs Selenium - Frontend E2E Testing Tutorial

children.name: Security Best Practices
children.description: Understand common web vulnerabilities like Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), clickjacking, and insecure direct object references. Implement Angular's built-in security features and follow best practices for secure coding, input sanitization, and protecting against common attacks.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Application Security Risks
Building Secure Angular Applications - A Must Have For Your Skillset!

children.name: Authentication & Authorization Strategies
children.description: Deep dive into implementing secure authentication and authorization in Angular applications. Explore common patterns like JWT (JSON Web Tokens), OAuth2, OpenID Connect. Learn to integrate with identity providers, manage tokens, implement route guards, and utilize HTTP interceptors for secure API communication.

resources.title: Angular Authentication Tutorial - Build a Login System from Scratch
Angular & NodeJS Auth Tutorial - Login, Register, & JWT

children.name: Monorepos, Micro Frontends & Web Components
children.description: Explore strategies for scaling large enterprise applications. Learn about monorepos with tools like Nx Workspace for managing multiple Angular applications and libraries. Understand micro frontend architectures for independent deployments and team scaling, and leverage Web Components for framework-agnostic UI elements.

resources.title: What is an Nx Monorepo? | Learn how to build scalable apps
Micro Frontends Tutorial - Building a Micro Frontend Architecture with React

children.name: Deployment & CI/CD
children.description: Learn to build and deploy Angular applications to various hosting platforms (e.g., Netlify, Vercel, Firebase Hosting, AWS S3/CloudFront, Azure Static Web Apps). Set up Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins for automated testing and deployment.

resources.title: Deploying an Angular App to Netlify with GitHub Actions

tree.name: Project & Career Advancement
tree.description: Apply all learned concepts to build a comprehensive portfolio project, solidify best practices, and prepare for career opportunities as a professional Angular Developer in the industry.

resources.title: How to Build a Portfolio Website (freeCodeCamp)
Build a Full-Stack Angular & Node.js App - Tutorial
How to Get a Junior Developer Job - 10 Tips for Your First Tech Job

children.name: Capstone Project: Enterprise Web Application
children.description: Build a substantial, full-stack Angular application from scratch that demonstrates mastery of core and advanced concepts. Focus on a clear problem statement, robust architecture, comprehensive testing, secure implementation, and documented deployment, mimicking a real-world enterprise project.

resources.title: Angular Tour of Heroes Tutorial (Official, project-based)
Build a Full-Stack E-commerce App with Angular, NestJS & MongoDB (MERN Stack Tutorial)

children.name: Angular Architecture, Code Quality & Best Practices
children.description: Adopt industry best practices for code quality: linting (ESLint), formatting (Prettier), effective project structuring (e.g., feature modules, core/shared modules, standalone components), architectural patterns (smart/dumb components, container/presenter), and design principles (SOLID, DRY, KISS) for scalable and maintainable Angular applications.

resources.title: Angular Project Structure Best Practices - Build an enterprise Angular Application
Angular Components: Smart vs Dumb (Container vs Presentational)

children.name: Soft Skills & Team Collaboration
children.description: Develop essential soft skills crucial for team environments, including effective communication, constructive conflict resolution, active participation in code reviews, mastering advanced Git collaboration workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, rebase), and understanding Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) for project management.

resources.title: Git Workflow - Mastering Git from basics to advanced
Agile vs Scrum vs Kanban - What's the Difference?

children.name: Portfolio, Interview Prep & Continuous Learning
children.description: Craft a compelling developer portfolio showcasing your Angular projects and skills. Prepare for technical interviews (covering data structures, algorithms, system design, and Angular-specific questions). Cultivate a mindset of continuous learning to stay current with the evolving web landscape, new Angular features, and ecosystem trends.

resources.title: How to Create a Portfolio Website for Developers – Full Course
Frontend Developer Interview Questions (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular)
